bio.title: About Mathias Huque
paragraphs: I'm a Software Engineer and final-year Systems Engineering student at Universidad ORT Uruguay, where I also teach Computer Science fundamentals and Data Structures & Algorithms. I focus on building reliable, well-structured systems across the stack, from architecture to implementation.

Teaching sharpens the way I engineer: explaining algorithms and abstractions clearly, and designing exercises that hold up under scrutiny, both push me toward code that is predictable, testable, and built to last. I approach engineering pragmatically, balancing technical depth with real-world constraints to ship solutions that are efficient, scalable, and maintainable.

Experience.title: My Experience RoadMap
Experience.subtitle: Journey through academia and industry, highlighting key roles and contributions along the way.

description: Design and teach a functional programming curriculum, guiding students to build and verify computable models from formal specifications
Develop standards for modular, side-effect-free code through pure functions, immutability, and recursion
Present programming as a mathematical activity, emphasizing abstraction, correctness, and formal reasoning
Design assignments that translate specifications into precise function definitions, achieving a first-attempt pass rate of over 90%
Led data structures and algorithms lab sessions for groups of 30+ students, providing personalized tutoring that improved grades for over 70% of those coached
Authored exercises and solution guides for 20+ problem sets, adopted in every subsequent edition of the course
Built and maintained 2,000+ lines of C++ code for labs and demonstrations, reinforcing core data structures and algorithmic techniques
Helped students translate abstract concepts into practical problem-solving skills

header.title: Selected Work
header.subtitle: A selection of projects spanning a full-stack capstone platform, algorithmic tooling, and developer utilities.

Projects.silo: A full-stack platform designed to centralize SONDA Uruguay's bidding process, improving decision traceability and the reuse of historical knowledge and project records.
Projects.siloDescriptionSecondary: Developed as my Systems Engineering capstone — spanning stakeholder discovery, AS-IS process analysis, requirements and backlog definition, and C4 architecture design, with a prototype validated by SONDA stakeholders and approved to move to delivery.
Projects.siloImageAlt: SILO bidding and opportunity management platform interface
Projects.siloPartnership: Capstone developed in collaboration with SONDA Uruguay.
Projects.portfolioWebsite: This portfolio — Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, bilingual via next-intl.
Projects.algorithmVisualizer: Step-by-step visualizations of core algorithms and data structures.
Projects.mlPlayground: Interactive lab for exploring machine learning
Projects.favForge: Favicon generator with live previews and export packages
Projects.myPdf: Client-side PDF conversion plus server-side merge and split — no account or file storage.
Projects.docuLens: Typed, evidence-backed PDF analysis — a LangGraph pipeline classifies and routes documents, validates every citation against the source before it's shown.
